lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad ihu guphaa veechaare ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.
The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai sabad suhaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaatee doojai bhaai kar laae ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.
He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ghaRee muhat kaa lekhaa levai rateeahu maasaa tol kadhaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||
One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality;
She shall weep bitterly in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kharee kuaalio kuroop kulakhanee supanai pir nahee paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||
She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world
His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman pir raakhiaa ka(n)th laai sabade pir raavai sej suhaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||
The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.
He enshrines His Name within our minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee anadin sadaa gun gaavaniaa ||8||28||29||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.
Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g rahahi sadaa ra(n)g raate har ras man tripataavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree paR bujh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh paRahi har naam salaahahi dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||
The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
He cannot be obtained by any effort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa kare taa satigur bhetai nadaree mel milaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||
One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.
He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tribidh ba(n)dhan tootahi gurasabadee gurasabadee mukat karaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man cha(n)chal vas na aavai ||
lines.translation: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.
Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh mahi raataa bikh hee maahi pachaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau kare tai aap janaae ||
lines.translation: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu karam karai kichh thaai na paae ||
lines.translation: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hovai bakhase sabad suhaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||
They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.
Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh janam gaiaa hai birathaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||
The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.
This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: halat na sobhaa palat na dhoee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam kinai viralai jaataa ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!
Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat kare din raatee sahaje hee sukh paavaniaa ||8||
lines.translation: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||
That One Lord is pervading in all.
Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate jan sohahi kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||9||29||30||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||
